capabilities: Attach a note to a folder
Open folder notes by clicking the folder name
Create folder notes for existing folders
Access folder notes through their path
Use Templater or templates for folder notes
extras: The beta version is installed via the BRAT plugin, and full documentation is hosted externally rather than in the README.
problem: Obsidian folders can only be collapsed or expanded, so there is no way to open a folder itself as a note.

relations.evidence: similar to the functionality offered in Notion
unique features that separate it from similar "Folder note" plugins

summary: Folder-note plugin that attaches a note to each folder so clicking the folder name opens it, like in Notion.
